'''Griz''' was a member of the [[Kiffu Guardians]]. In [[137 ABY]], Griz was part of a team, along with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Teph]] and [[Ahnah Rawk]], that tried to stop a brawl near the [[Busted Blaster]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], but they were beaten by [[Cade Skywalker]].<ref name="Legacy 35" />
